result.summary: All 3 test-file edits applied exactly per the design doc, plus the §5 orphaned-row cleanup. mix compile: clean, 0 warnings (263 files, `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --force`). mix test on the 3 target files: 103/104 passed, 1 FAILED -- test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs's 'creates a tenant row, provisions a real schema, and replays real migrations' (line 387). Root cause (newly discovered, not covered by the design doc or CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's review): wrapping the test body in SandboxAutoMode.provision!/2 per design §1.2 causes provision!/2's own `after` block to restore Letflow.Repo to :manual mode + a fresh checkout, owned by the TEST process, as soon as the wrapped fn returns -- i.e. before the test function itself returns and before ExUnit tears the test process down. The test's own on_exit/1 (registered INSIDE the wrapped fn, running its DROP SCHEMA / delete_all cleanup) only fires afterward, from ExUnit.OnExitHandler's own separate process. By then the pool is back in :manual mode with the connection checked out to a process that no longer exists, so OnExitHandler's DB call raises `DBConnection.OwnershipError: cannot find ownership process ... using mode :manual`. This did not happen before this fix specifically because the old code leaked :auto mode indefinitely (the bug this issue exists to close) -- on_exit's query 'just worked' against a real, unclaimed :auto-mode connection. Design §1.2's own claim ('on_exit/1's own process-registration semantics are unaffected by being nested one level deeper') addressed registration mechanics only, not the pool-mode timing relative to when on_exit actually executes -- that gap is what fails now. §2 (identity_test.exs:1381) and §3 (role_registry_test.exs:119) enter_auto_mode!/1 swaps are pure refactors as designed and both pass -- all identity_test.exs and role_registry_test.exs tests green, including the exact describe blocks/on_exit callbacks touched (REQ-076 AC6 role registry routes; RoleRegistryTest's own setup). Orphaned-row cleanup: pre-cleanup count 129 (confirmed, matching ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis), 0 mix test processes running concurrently (checked first). Ran design §5.2's exact command: it raised a foreign-key violation the design doc did not anticipate (`entity_column_promotions_tenant_id_fkey`) -- 124 of the 129 orphaned tenants had child rows in `entity_column_promotions` (itself leftover from the ColumnPromotionTest AC1 flake `sandbox_auto_mode.ex`'s own moduledoc names as the original motivating case for this whole helper). Flagging this deviation explicitly rather than silently editing the design: to unblock, ran one additional delete scoped only to the same tenant ids already being purged (`DELETE FROM entity_column_promotions WHERE tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants)`, deleting 985 rows) before deleting the 129 tenants -- test-DB-only, additive to §5.2's own intent (purging orphaned tenants and everything that exists only to reference them), no production data or code touched. Post-cleanup count verified 0 per §5.4.
issues: tenants_test.exs's provision!/2 wrap (design §1.2) causes a DBConnection.OwnershipError in the test's own on_exit/1 cleanup callback -- see summary for full root cause. This is a design-level gap, not an implementation error against the design doc (the wrap was applied exactly as specified). Needs CODE-DESIGNER rework of §1 (e.g. registering on_exit's own body to re-enter :auto mode itself, or restructuring so on_exit is registered outside provision!/2's wrapped fn) and a fresh CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR pass before ELIXIR-DEV re-applies it.

Design §5.2's cleanup command is incomplete as written -- it does not account for entity_column_promotions' FK to tenants. Worth folding into the design doc's own record for future reruns of this maintenance command, though not blocking (resolved ad hoc this run, scoped to the exact tenant ids purged).
